Description: Choose ONE primary support channel. Don't spread across 5 channels you can't monitor.
Do: Start with email or Discord. Add live chat only at 100+ daily users.
Dont: Don't promise 24/7 support as a solo founder. Don't use phone support at Stage 3.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③: 1 channel monitored well > 5 channels monitored poorly

Description: Set realistic response times AND communicate them. Under-promise over-deliver.
Do: 'We respond within 24 hours on business days.' Then respond in 4 hours.
Dont: Don't promise 1-hour response you can't keep. Don't leave people waiting 5 days.
Giantiny_Note: Solo founder realistic SLA: 24hr. Don't pretend to be a team of 50.

Description: 80% of support questions are the same 10 questions. Document them once answer forever.
Do: Write FAQ for your top 10 support questions. Put them on a /help page. Update monthly.
Dont: Don't wait for 100 questions to start documenting. Don't write docs nobody can find.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③: Docs = code. Write once answer 1000 times.

Description: Make it easy to report bugs. Structured format = faster fixes. In-app button preferred.
Do: Add bug report button or link. Template: What happened / What expected / Steps to reproduce / Screenshot.
Dont: Don't require sign-up to report bugs. Don't ignore bug reports for > 48 hours.
Giantiny_Note: Make the path from bug report to fix visible. Users appreciate transparency.

Description: Collect feature requests systematically. Let users vote. Use data not gut for roadmap.
Do: Set up Canny or GitHub Discussions. Review weekly. Share what you're building and why.
Dont: Don't build every request. Don't ignore patterns. Don't promise timelines you can't keep.
Giantiny_Note: Listen to the 'Very Disappointed' segment (Sean Ellis) — their requests matter most.

Description: Create canned responses for top 10 questions. Auto-tag and auto-route common issues.
Do: Write 10 template responses. Set up auto-responder for off-hours. Tag by category.
Dont: Don't automate empathy. Don't make users feel like they're talking to a robot.
Giantiny_Note: Giantiny ③: Automate repetitive support. Humanize complex issues.

Description: When a user cancels ask why. 1 question survey. Use data to fix product not convince them to stay.
Do: Cancel flow: 1-question 'Why are you leaving?' + offer to help. Track reasons monthly.
Dont: Don't make cancellation hard (dark patterns). Don't beg. Don't guilt-trip.
Giantiny_Note: Every churn reason is a product improvement opportunity. Track patterns.

Description: Track: tickets/week resolution time CSAT top categories. Goal: trending down.
Do: Weekly review: How many tickets? How fast resolved? What category? CSAT score?
Dont: Don't optimize for ticket count without quality. Don't ignore CSAT.
Giantiny_Note: Decreasing tickets = better product + better docs. That's the goal.

Description: Don't wait for support tickets. Proactively reach out to struggling users.
Do: Set up automated check-in emails at day 3 7 14. Flag users with low activation.
Dont: Don't spam. Don't be creepy ('I noticed you haven't logged in'). Be helpful.
Giantiny_Note: Proactive support = reduces churn + increases activation. Net positive ROI.

Description: Define severity levels and response expectations. Critical = product down. High = feature broken. Medium = inconvenience.
Do: Severity 1: respond in 1hr fix in 4hr. Severity 2: respond in 4hr fix in 24hr. Severity 3: respond in 24hr.
Dont: Don't treat everything as critical. Don't ignore true critical issues because it's weekend.
Giantiny_Note: Even solo founders need an escalation plan. Phone alerts for Severity 1.
